parole.significato: A member of any of a group of Protestant churches or denominations in the Anabaptist tradition, practicing credobaptism…
parole.testo: Eponymous to Menno Simons, the second-generation leader of the denomination, + -ite. Menno's own name is of West Frisian origin and was originally spelled Minne (compare the name Mein, itself ultimately related to *magan (“to be able”)).
